_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Fort Myers Beach & Sanibel. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Calusa Nature Center & Planetarium
deals.deal: Discounts for seniors, students, military, first responders and AAA; under 3 free
deals.details: General admission is $13 for adults and $7 for children 3-12; the center lists discounts for seniors, students, military, first responders and AAA members without stating the amounts.

deals.name: Edison & Ford Winter Estates
deals.deal: Military veterans $2 off admission + 10% off Museum Store
deals.details: Veterans receive $2 off admission and 10% off Museum Store items year-round. SNAP/EBT cardholders get general admission for up to 4 people through Museums for All (not special events, guided tours or Holiday Nights).

deals.name: Tarpon Bay Explorers (Nature & Sealife Cruise)
deals.details: Rates are $35 for adults and $25 for children, tax not included.

deals.name: Tarpon Bay Explorers (Refuge Tram Tour)
deals.deal: J.N. "Ding" Darling refuge tram tour $22 adults, $13 children
deals.details: Guided tram tour of the wildlife refuge; $22 adults, $13 children, tax not included. Pickup is at 900 Tarpon Bay Rd.

deals.name: Coconut Jack's Waterfront Grille
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-6 PM: drink specials + bar bites
deals.details: Daily drink specials at the bar and throughout the restaurant; the bar bites menu is served in the bar area only.

deals.name: JWB Grill
deals.deal: $12 martinis Mondays + 50% off featured wine bottles Wednesdays
deals.details: Martini Mondays: $12 handcrafted martinis every Monday. Wine Down Wednesday: 50% off featured bottles from a curated selection.

deals.name: License to Chill Bar & Grill
deals.deal: $5 drafts and cans, $8 wells, $10 cocktails and frozen drinks, daily 1-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour daily 1-5 PM: $5 16 oz drafts and canned beers or seltzers, $8 well drinks, $10 specialty cocktails, frozen drinks and select wines.

deals.name: Matanzas on the Bay
deals.deal: $2.75 domestic bottles, $3.50 wells and house wine, daily 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour bar menu also includes $5 spritzers and lemonades and a $6 Fire-Chata shot. The menu lists 3-6 PM daily; the site footer lists happy hour as 11 AM-6 PM Mon-Fri.

deals.name: Matanzas on the Bay (Petey's Upper Deck)
deals.details: Sundays at Petey's Upper Deck with steel drums, a reggae band and a DJ; a bucket of 5 beers is $30.

deals.name: The Sanibel Grill
deals.deal: $2 off wells and house wine + $3 Bud Light and Shock Top drafts, daily 4-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour every day from 4 to 6 PM.

deals.name: Yucatan Beach Stand Tiki Bar & Grill
deals.details: Happy hour runs Monday to Friday, 2 to 5 PM; prices are on the bar's separate happy hour menu.

deals.name: Lazy Flamingo (Fort Myers)
deals.deal: Bring your catch, they cook it: $10.99 (up to 10 oz)
deals.details: "Your Catch" is $10.99 per order, maximum 10 oz.

deals.name: Lazy Flamingo (Sanibel)
deals.deal: Bring your catch, they cook it: $10.99 (up to 10 oz)
deals.details: "Your Catch" is $10.99 per order, maximum 10 oz.

deals.name: License to Chill Bar & Grill
deals.details: Happy hour small bites at $10: Bay Bread, Pork Nachos, or Chicken Tinga Tacos with chips and salsa.

deals.name: Matanzas on the Bay
deals.deal: Happy hour bites from $5: con queso $5, wings or fish dip $7, half-order oysters $10
deals.details: Happy hour kitchen menu also lists coconut shrimp and calamari at $8 and buffalo shrimp at $9. The menu lists 3-6 PM daily.
